notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
# Add reroll button
Cost 0 ~ 
Put all the cards in hand into the deck and draw that number of cards.
The cost increase by 10 gold each time you reroll

> Cycle card have been deleted


# Modify Card Effect
Gold Powder
Increases the tower's value by (150).

# Bug fix

+

notes.title: Update 0.1c
notes.content:
#Add new card
- Surprise Attack[Rarity:Normal / Cost:5]
Inflicts 300 damage to enemies.
If you kill an enemy with this card, get 30 gold.

- Backdoor Dealings[Rarity:Rare / Cost:30]
Reduces the cost of tower cards in hand by 15.

- Small Launcher[Rarity:Rare / Cost:40]
Grants Missile to Machine type towers with a value of 120 or less.

*The three cards above are included in the default deck.


#Add and modify skills
- Rapid Shot skill added to Cold Shooter
Attacks have a 8% chance to quickly shoot at enemy three times
Each shot deals damage equal to tower's damage.

- Electric Discharge skill added to Bolt Tower
Attacks have a 30% chance to releases electricity in three directions that applies electric shock to enemy and inflicts 30 magic damage 

- Magician Death Touch skill modification
> Attacks have a 20% chance to apply weaken to enemies, reducing armor by 20 and dealing magic damage by 28

- Missile skill added
Attacks have a 10% chance to fire a missile that deals damage equal to 30 + tower's damage to enemies


#Modify Card Effect
- Spiderweb
Reduces the value of towers with a value of [180] or less by 50.
> Reduces the value of towers with a value of [200] or less by 50.

- Corrosion
Reduces the value of towers with a value of [250] or less by 80.
> Reduces the value of towers with a value of [270] or less by 80.




# Skill damage is displayed in blue text.
